title: Doubles Communication Codes (Michelle Grogan)
style: fast phonk progressive trance heavy bongo bass guitar 134bpm pickleball training high energy English Spanish coach calls no slow sections
lyrics:
[Intro]
Two voices, one team, one court
Communication codes in doubles, the short report

[Verse 1]
Ball in the air between both players wide
Call it loud so your partner steps aside
I GOT IT means the ball belongs to you
YOURS means step back, it is coming through

Bounce means let the ball land first before
Mine means move aside, I have this in store
Call it early, call it loud, call it clear
Doubles communication, both must hear

[Pre-Chorus]
I got it, yours, bounce, switch
Four calls cover every situation in the pitch
Call it early, call it loud
Doubles communication, clear and proud

[Chorus]
Communication codes in doubles play
I got it, yours, bounce, switch all day
Call it early, one clear voice
Doubles communication, make the choice

[Verse 2]
After the point, talk between serves fast
Where did that ball land, what line was last
Are you comfortable at the kitchen line
Shall we stack this point, is the formation fine

Between every point a five second code
Confirm the plan, confirm the road
Stack left, stack right, stay straight
Doubles communication, do not wait

[Bridge]
Bluey: Perfect communication between the two of them, both knew exactly where to be
Trevor: Between-point communication reduces positioning errors by forty-one percent
Michelle: Loud. Early. One call. No silence between points.

[Chorus]
Communication codes in doubles play
I got it, yours, bounce, switch all day
Call it early, one clear voice
Doubles communication, make the choice

[Outro]
Loud and early
One clear call
Doubles communication codes
